verdict:
KILL. The triage did the court's work and reached the right answer, and the reason it could is that both the bull pole and the bear pole turned out to be resolvable from primary disclosure.

THE BULL CASE IS A SCREEN ARTIFACT, AND IT IS THE CLEANEST AGGREGATION-ARTIFACT INSTANCE IN THIS BATCH. Vendor data shows ADTN at EV $845M and 0.74x EV/sales today against $1,245M and 1.15x in December 2025 - a $400M EV collapse while market cap barely moved ($694M to $682M). The arithmetic identifies the cause exactly: the December EV included the $373.3M redeemable non-controlling interest and the August EV does not. Rebuild it properly for a common holder - $682M cap plus $201.3M converts plus $25M revolver less $79.2M cash plus leases, and critically ADD BACK the $359.2M mezzanine claim that sits SENIOR to common - and you get roughly $1.19B on $1.14B TTM revenue, about 1.04x, not 0.74x. At the never-yet-achieved 10% long-term operating-margin target on $310-320M per quarter that is about 9.5x EBIT: the tape is already pricing a FULL recovery. Any EV/sales screen will keep mis-flagging this name until the mezzanine is handled, which makes this a live screen defect rather than a one-name error.

THE MEZZANINE IS NOT A FOOTNOTE, IT IS 53% OF THE MARKET CAP. The $359.2M redeemable NCI is the DPLTA put: EUR 292.6M / $334.2M of aggregate exit compensation accruing guaranteed interest at 5.0% plus 1.27% = 6.27%, with Meiningen appraisal litigation seeking a HIGHER price and no final decision expected until late 2027 or 2028, plus EUR 7.6M / $8.7M per year of recurring compensation. Against that, cash is $79.2M. The quarter's $22.6M outflow was net Adtran Networks SE minority buy-ins plus that compensation - which is to say real free cash flow is being consumed retiring the mezzanine rather than accruing to common. And it is unresolvable on any tradeable horizon by construction: a German appraisal court will rule in 2027 or 2028.

THE BEAR CASE NEEDS NO COURT BECAUSE MANAGEMENT GUIDED IT FORWARD ITSELF. Non-GAAP operating margin was 3.8% in Q2-26 against 6.9% in Q1-26 and 4.8% for FY25; gross margin 40.7% against 43.0% and 41.4%. The Q3 guide is 1.5-5.5%, a 3.5% midpoint - BELOW the already-impaired Q2 actual. Revenue is not the damage at all: $281.1M, +6.1% year over year, Optical $109.7M +22%, hyperscaler +97%. This is a margin event, self-reported twice (the 07-21 preliminary warning and the 08-03 print), on a constraint management explicitly declines to date - 'optical amplifiers... certain pieces of silicon... PC boards', and 'I don't think it'll disappear next year, or what quarter it would disappear if it does'. There is nothing for a bench to adjudicate between a company that guided the break forward and a screen artifact that manufactured the cheapness.

The honest summary is that ADTN is a decent revenue story - the AI-optical and hyperscaler lines are genuinely growing - sitting behind a senior mezzanine claim that consumes the cash flow, priced as if the never-achieved margin target were already in hand.

court.record: batch4 8/15; red None/blue None NO COURT - triage-routed straight from REFUTABILITY to ADJUDICATE on a court-worthiness score of 5/10, explicitly below the >=6 dispatch threshold. The single REFUTABILITY artifact (2026-08-15 12:39Z) is the entire record, and it is unusually decisive for a triage: both poles were resolved from filings before any bench was needed.

reopen_gates: EVENT: Q3 non-GAAP gross margin >= 42% TOGETHER WITH operating margin at or above the 5.5% guide high end. Both legs required - this would be the first evidence the component-cost shock is transient rather than structural, and management has explicitly refused to date its end.

EVENT (the one that actually changes the equity): a Meiningen appraisal ruling, or a negotiated squeeze-out, that CAPS or SETTLES the EUR 292.6M put. Until then 53% of the market cap sits senior to common and compounds at 6.27%.
DATA: a MicroMux Quattro or LiteWave800 hyperscaler design win with DISCLOSED dollars - the revenue line is already growing, so only a sized, named win changes the margin math.

SCREEN FIX (not a name gate, but it belongs here): re-run the excess-drawdown against comm-equipment and optical peers rather than the Utilities sector median, and rebuild EV to include the redeemable NCI, before this name is ever re-queued.
